text:
olivia.p: FYI - BigBox Corp's PO from the marketplace failed validation: portal returned attachment_malformed for their signed bundle. They're on a tight launch window.
sam.s: What's the exact error payload?
jack.ops: paste from logs: `422 Unprocessable Entity {"error":"attachment_malformed","msg":"zip contains nested signatures; normalization removed bytes"}`
harry.eng: looks like our normalization strips zero-width bytes that AdobeSign includes in envelope metadata. That breaks the signature checksum.
marketplace-bot: deploy 2026-03-10 patch removed strict byte-preservation for attachments (reason: performance).
olivia.p: customer insists on non-altered signed artifacts. Sales asks for a stop-gap so provisioning can continue.
neda.legal: We can't silently accept modified signed docs. Proposal: enable an "original_bytes" opt-in for specific customers; require signed waiver negating Redwood liability for signature verification.
harry.eng: Tech estimate: 1 engineer, 1 day to add opt-in header and bypass normalization in ingestion path + add zip-depth and size limits. Need ops for canary.
jack.ops: Ops comfortable enabling canary route behind feature flag with quotas and zip-scan.
sam.s: Please draft the waiver text and I'll request customer signature now.
neda.legal: Drafting: "Customer requests ingestion of original signed artifacts without content normalization. Customer acknowledges responsibility for signature verification and indemnifies Redwood for signature-related disputes." Sending DM.
olivia.p: once signed we can enable canary for BigBox. Harry - please prioritize small PR.
harry.eng: will open PR and link MP-6007.
marketplace-bot: ticket MP-6007 created: "opt-in-original-bytes-canary" assigned to @harry.eng.
